info.title: API.SH: Netflix
info.description: The Netflix API from API.SH: public Netflix data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Films, series and new seasons added to Netflix in a country on a given day (or announced as upcoming). Each title has its Netflix id and link, type, title, original title, year, release date, description, runtime, age rating, genres, production countries, IMDb and TMDB ids and scores, Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer, poster, video qualities on Netflix (SD, HD, 4K), the date it leaves Netflix when announced, and audio and subtitle languages. New seasons carry the series title, `season_title` and `season_number`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/netflix-new

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code of the Netflix catalogue (US, GB, DE, IN, BR, JP, KR ...). Default US.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day the titles were added (YYYY-MM-DD). Default yesterday.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: new (added that day, default) or upcoming (announced).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: movie or show. Default both.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genre codes: act (action), ani (animation), cmy (comedy), crm (crime), doc (documentary), drm (drama), eur (European), fml (family), fnt (fantasy), hrr (horror), hst (history), msc (music), rly (reality TV), rma (romance), scf (sci-fi), spt (sport), trl (thriller), war, wsn (western).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of titles and descriptions. Default en.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Titles per page, 1-40. Default 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor: pass `next_cursor` back; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Netflix film or series by its id: title, synopsis, year, maturity rating and level, content warning, Netflix original flag, genres and Netflix genre ids, moods and tags, cast, creators and directors with person ids, audio and subtitle languages, download availability, trailers and featurettes, images (poster, billboard, hero, logo), similar titles and the plans with their prices. For a series: every season with its id, label and total runtime, and every episode with its id, number, title, synopsis, runtime and still image. Also IMDb and TMDB ids and scores, Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer, original release date and production countries, and `availability`: the countries (of 93 Netflix markets) where it streams on Netflix, with video qualities and the date it leaves when announced. Set `availability=0` to skip the country check.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/netflix-title

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Netflix title id, the number in netflix.com/title/<id> (80057281 = Stranger Things). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A netflix.com title link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Include the countries where the title streams on Netflix. Default true.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of the episode texts filled in for older seasons. Default en.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Netflix's official weekly Top 10, global or for one of 93 countries: rank, Netflix id and link, title, series name and season, synopsis, release year, maturity rating, weeks in the Top 10, and for the global lists weekly views, hours viewed and runtime. Global lists have four categories (English and non-English films and TV); country lists have films and tv. Weeks run Monday to Sunday and are named by the Sunday; lists start 2021-06-27.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/netflix-top10

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for a country list (US, GB, BR, KR, IN ...). Leave empty for the global lists.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: films (default), films-non-english, tv or tv-non-english. Country lists: films or tv.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: The Sunday that ends the week (YYYY-MM-DD). Default the latest week.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
